correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact star adjacency spectrum ±sqrt(m),0 yields D=(c+sqrt(m))/c for c≥sqrt(m). Edge-added graph splits into a 3-class quotient with cubic x³−x²−mx+m−2, plus −1 and zeros. Root signs prove γ<−1<0<β<1<sqrt(m)<α, yielding D+=(c+α)/(c+β). For m≥4, rational tests f_m(2/5)>0 and f_m(sqrt(m)+2/5)>0 imply α−sqrt(m)<2/5<β, so damping strictly falls for all c≥sqrt(m). For m=3 exact root brackets give a single positive crossing c*=sqrt(3)β/(α−β−sqrt(3))≈4.245360630265; m=2 is the explicit triangle and always improves. PF strict increase of Perron root follows from added positive edges and connectedness. 56 independent exact-graph eigenvalue/range comparisons m=2..15 corroborated analytic inequalities.
